svg.aria-label: Rays marched up through the same heap of cloud. When every ray starts at the entry point, neighbouring rays sample the same slices, and the texels, shaded by how many samples fell inside the cloud, form bands. When each ray starts a random fraction of a step later, the same texels break up into fine noise.
